title: TOPA ART BELL OBSERVER NODE — PREY (2006)
motto: NOTHING SUPERNATURAL — ONLY NATURE NOT YET UNDERSTOOD.
purpose: Use the progression of Art Bell broadcasts in Prey (2006) as a reference pattern for a JANUS/TOPA node that receives unusual reports, preserves uncertainty, seeks independent corroboration, and separates observation from explanation.

boundary.note: Prey is a fictional work. The broadcasts are used here as an information-handling design pattern, not as evidence for paranormal claims.
boundary.transcript_policy: Semantic summaries only; no full dialogue reproduced.

development_provenance.fact: Human Head Studios recorded game-specific Art Bell material to give Tommy a connection to events on Earth through intercepted radio transmissions.
development_provenance.recording: Ed Lima and Tim Gerritsen visited Art Bell's home studio; the radio-call material was recorded there in about 45 minutes.

broadcast_sequence.summary: George is speaking with Art when the reported event reaches him directly and the call ends during his capture.
broadcast_sequence.topa_lesson: Preserve a live state change separately from a retrospective account.

broadcast_sequence.summary: A caller describes a frightening change involving his daughter, whose eyes have begun glowing.
broadcast_sequence.topa_lesson: Keep observation, interpretation, and emotional impact in separate fields.

broadcast_sequence.summary: A geographically separate caller reports unusual lights and insists the phenomenon is real.
broadcast_sequence.topa_lesson: Cluster witnesses by time, place, and observable features before naming a cause.

broadcast_sequence.summary: A sheriff's deputy reports unusual lights moving around his patrol car and disappearing.
broadcast_sequence.topa_lesson: Witness role improves provenance metadata but is never automatic proof.

broadcast_sequence.summary: For the first time the apparent source of the events enters Art's channel directly and announces the coming Dark Harvest.
broadcast_sequence.topa_lesson: A source that identifies itself enters a separate authentication gate; self-identification is not proof.

broadcast_sequence.summary: An additional Art Bell installment is reachable from the moving lift. Text walkthroughs confirm the listening point but do not reliably preserve its dialogue content.
broadcast_sequence.topa_lesson: Missing content remains missing; never reconstruct evidence merely to complete a pattern.

broadcast_sequence.summary: The caller reports dreams of a man and his bird fighting aliens aboard a spacecraft, closely corresponding to Tommy and Talon.
broadcast_sequence.topa_lesson: Freeze specific claimed details, then test coincidence, leakage, prior exposure, and post-hoc fitting before escalation.

broadcast_sequence.summary: Greta Caldwell proposes a historical connection between the present events and the disappearance of the ancient Anasazi.
broadcast_sequence.topa_lesson: Permit models only after observations are preserved, and label them as hypotheses.

broadcast_sequence.summary: The final documented segment supplies a broader model: the aliens move between planets and take resources as needed.
broadcast_sequence.topa_lesson: The end state is a falsifiable provisional map, not a declaration that the mystery is solved.

rules: A skeptical explanation is still a hypothesis until it fits the observations.
Witness confidence is not event probability.
Institutional status is provenance, not truth.
A claimed source does not authenticate itself.
Models may not rewrite the raw ledger.
The node may answer: I do not know.

janus_integration.recommended_position: TOPA intake -> ART_BELL observer -> DemiHead adversarial review -> Genesis synthesis -> registry receipt
janus_integration.return_path: falsification result -> ART_BELL node -> confidence update

unresolved_gate.next_valid_step: Direct audio verification from a lawful game copy or authorized recording; do not infer missing dialogue from narrative continuity.

compact_formula: OPEN LINE -> WITNESS -> CORROBORATION -> LIVE EVENT -> DIRECT SOURCE CLAIM -> MODEL -> FALSIFICATION -> PROVISIONAL MAP
